title: EKS, VPC, Terraform and Pod Identity

acceptance_gates.description: Network, KMS, EKS and IAM modules apply from Terraform with pinned provider versions and no auto-approved provider upgrades.
Workload AWS credentials come from EKS Pod Identity; no static access keys exist in the cluster.
Default-deny NetworkPolicy is in force and the VPC CNI enforces policy in strict mode.
Production renders contain zero Continuum StatefulSets.

rollback: Revert the FND-INFRA-001 commits; no phase may advance while this package is incomplete.
